title: Real-Imag to Complex
text: Convert real and/or imaginary inputs to complex signal, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Input} sets the real, imaginary, {Imag part} sets the imaginary part of complex output and {Real part}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Re
ports.summary: Real part of complex output scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Im
ports.summary: Imaginary part of complex output scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Real or imaginary part of complex output scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Input
params.values: Real, imaginary, or both Real (default) | Imag | Real and imag

params.name: Imag part
params.values: Imaginary part of complex output 0 (default) | finite scalar, vector, or matrix

params.name: Real part
params.values: Real part of complex output 0 (default) | finite scalar, vector, or matrix
